DESCRIPTION: ADM-OSC v1.0: object-based audio positions and gains for any processor that speaks it - L-ISA, Spat Revolution, Holophonix, Fletcher Machine, SpaceMap Go, the DS100 through En-Bridge. 64 objects; a processor with more takes a file written with --objects.

SOURCES: immersive-audio-live/ADM-OSC, ADM-OSC v1.0 (living standard, 15 June 2026), the object, environment and listener address tables - https://immersive-audio-live.github.io/ADM-OSC/
AES, ADM-OSC specification v1.0 and implementation guide (the same tables, published)

obj.DESCRIPTION: The objects, by number from one.

azim.DESCRIPTION: Azimuth, in degrees: nought ahead, positive to the left.

elev.DESCRIPTION: Elevation, in degrees: nought level, positive up.

dist.DESCRIPTION: Distance, normalised: one is the reference distance.

aed.DESCRIPTION: Azimuth, elevation and distance in one message.

x.DESCRIPTION: Left to right, normalised: minus one to one.

y.DESCRIPTION: Back to front, normalised: minus one to one.

z.DESCRIPTION: Bottom to top, normalised: minus one to one.

xy.DESCRIPTION: X and Y in one message.

xyz.DESCRIPTION: X, Y and Z in one message.

gain.DESCRIPTION: Gain, linear: one is unity; the receiver clamps what it cannot take.

dmax.DESCRIPTION: The distance, in metres, that a normalised distance of one means.
